**`GraphView<V>`** — declares the three read-only query methods (`vertices()`, `vertexCount()`, `neighbors()`) and extends `Iterable<V>` so the for-each and iterator contract is also part of the read-only interface. It contains no mutation methods — those remain exclusively on `Graph.Builder`.

**`BreadthFirstSearch`** — `Graph<V>` replaced with `GraphView<V>` throughout (`stream`, `traverse`, and `BfsIterator`). The traversal logic has no reason to know it's operating on a concrete `Graph`; it only needs the read-only contract. This means `BreadthFirstSearch` can now also operate on any future `GraphView` implementation without modification.
